It certifies a unique fixed graph only for the localized map. It certifies no optimal radius, original-map invariant manifold or SSM, C1 or higher smoothness, spectral-quotient uniqueness, normal attraction, basin, long trajectory, other grid, force, wall boundary or D3Q27 result.
